question.text: Per the workbook, the requirement for portfolio managers to furnish Most Important Terms and Conditions (MITC) to clients is linked to a SEBI circular issued in:

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook traces the MITC requirement to a May 2024 SEBI circular (referenced via the APMI submission), which prescribes a concise MITC document covering fees, risks, exit terms, and grievance redressal for PMS client onboarding. The Trap: Other dates such as January 2020 (PM Regulations year) or September 2025 (other PMS reforms) are not the workbook-cited source for MITC. A date such as October 1, 2024 appears in the workbook only in a buyback taxation context, not for MITC. Note: Retain a client-acknowledged copy of the MITC alongside the disclosure document and agreement, since SEBI inspections check for evidence of MITC delivery against the May 2024 circular reference.
